types: Pushing (hitting a robot to disrupt their aim)
Pinning (Stopping robots from moving so they couldn't aim)
Blocking (Getting in their way preventing motion across zones)
defense.comments: Did lots of lane defense on bump and trench that worked well. Using pinning and blocking to prevent 5026 from shooting

qual.comments: Got penalties in auto because they were shooting from the neutral zone(accident bc they got stuck on the trench ledge)
